[[Artor Bobani Kiroz]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for items.

==Locations==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|Altrumm Ruins|outpost}}

==Dialogue==
:''"The horns of [[warden]]s are used in different ways. Adolescent ones can be used to enchant wands and staves, as they are full of energy and vigor. Adult horns are effective in reinforcing armor and shields. The oldest are nigh impossible to work with due to their stone-like hardness, and are used in magical brushes and instruments prized by the more artistic [[Great House|Kurzick Houses]]. In exchange for 5 [[Warden Horn]]s, I will give you this:"''

{{:Artor Bobani Kiroz/Collector}}

==Trivia==
This character's name is supposedly a tribute to Arthur Bobany de Queiroz, the Alpha Tester of the game and one of the Strategy Researchers for Prima Official [[Factions]] Strategy Guide. He belonged to the Amazon Basin guild.
